title: Bubble scatter
description: One translucent needle bubble per item: across on a log scale ticked at powers of ten, up on a linear scale from zero, area proportional to size. Largest drawn first so small ones stay on top, each labelled on the side with room; an optional reference line and axis names in the eyebrow type.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="bubble-scatter", role="img", the summary and data-focus; measures its width and draws the plot at height.
A group per item: the circle (needle-700 at 60%, needle-900 stroke) and its label; data-focused on the focused one, siblings step back on hover.
The y axis's name at the top left and the x axis's at the bottom right, mono 2xs uppercase.

usage: x must be positive (log scale); y is linear from zero; size drives area, not radius, so a figure twice another reads as twice the bubble.
Pass reference for a line the reader compares against: the league average, parity.
Three formatters write the summary and the ticks: formatX, formatY and formatSize, with tick variants when the axis wants a shorter form.
All bubbles wear one colour; the position and area carry the data. A second series is a second chart.
